title: Embedding a machine configuration
statement: Let $m\le k$, let $\iota$ map symbols in $S$ to symbols in $B$, and let $c$ be a configuration of an $m$-work-tape machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$, on input $x$. The embedded configuration maps each state through $\iota$, preserves the input-head position and output, and places the original tapes and head positions in the first $m$ slots; every additional tape is blank with its head at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration on input $x$ with $m$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states in $S$
